Title: Log in with valid email and password
Steps: Open the login page | Enter a valid email and password | Click Log in
Expected: The My orders page is shown

Title: Reject empty email and password
Steps: Open the login page | Leave both fields empty | Click Log in
Expected: Both fields show a required-field error

Title: Accept a password of exactly 8 characters
Steps: Enter the email | Enter the 8-character password | Click Log in

Title: Reject a password of 65 characters
Steps: Enter a valid email | Enter a 65-character password | Click Log in
Expected: A password length error is shown

Title: Lock the account after 5 wrong passwords
Steps: Enter the email with a wrong password 5 times | Enter the correct password
Expected: Login is refused and the account stays locked for 15 minutes

Title: Use the same error for unknown email and wrong password
Steps: Log in with an unknown email | Log in with a known email and wrong password | Compare the messages
Expected: Both attempts show the same generic error
